content: शुभ् I. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (शोभते) .²1 To shine, be splendid, look beautiful or handsome; सुष्ठु शोभसे एतेन विनयमाहात्म्येन <ls>U. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 6</ls>. .²2 To appear to advantage; सुखं हि दुःखान्यनुभूय शोभते <ls>Mk. 1. 10</ls>. .²3 To suit, become, befit (with <ab>gen.</ab>); रामभद्र इत्येवोपचारः शोभते तातपरिजनस्य <ls>U. 1</ls>. .²4 To be gay or happy. .²5 To be victorious. --II. €6 <ab>P.</ab> (शुभति) To shine; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (शोभयति-ते) To decorate, adorn, grace. --{%With%} परि, वि to shine, look splendid.
शुभ् {%f.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Beauty, splendour. .²2 Radiance, lustre. .²3 Happiness. .²4 Victory. .²5 An ornament. .²6 An auspicious offering. .²7 Water. .²8 A brilliant chariot.
